check.arg: want='mysqld' total=0; stopped=0; i=0 while [ "$i" -lt 5 ]; do total=0; stopped=0 for d in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(cat "$d/comm" 2>/dev/null) || continue [ "$c" = "$want" ] || continue total=$((total + 1)) st=$(sed -n 's/^State:[[:space:]]*//p' "$d/status" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1) case "$st" in T|t) stopped=$((stopped + 1)) ;; esac done # 已经有 T 状态进程 → 注入生效；一个匹配进程都没有 → 目标写错，重试也没用 if [ "$stopped" -gt 0 ] || [ "$total" -eq 0 ]; then break; fi i=$((i + 1)); sleep 1 done enforced=false; [ "$stopped" -gt 0 ] && enforced=true if [ "$total" -eq 0 ]; then summary='没有找到 comm 等于目标名的进程（process-cmd 写错或进程已退出）' elif [ "$enforced" = true ]; then summary='目标进程已进入 T 状态（SIGSTOP 生效）' else summary='找到了目标进程，但没有一个处于 T 状态' fi printf '{"enforced": %s, "summary": "%s", "checks": [{"name": "target_process_in_T_state", "observed": "%s/%s", "expected": ">=1 stopped of matched", "matched": %s}]}\n' \ "$enforced" "$summary" "$stopped" "$total" "$enforced"

probe() { out=$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$1" 2>&1) if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then printf '%s' "$out"; return; fi case "$out" in *ermission?denied*) printf 'unreadable' ;; *) printf 'absent' ;; esac } src='/var/lib/mysql/client-cert.pem' dst_dir='/var/lib/mysql/sys' dst="${dst_dir%/}/$(basename "$src")" s=$(probe "$src") d=$(probe "$dst") if [ "$s" = unreadable ] || [ "$d" = unreadable ]; then echo "self-check cannot read path (permission denied): src=$s dst=$d" >&2 exit 2 fi dest=false; [ "$d" != absent ] && dest=true moved=false; if [ "$d" != absent ] && [ "$s" != "$d" ]; then moved=true; fi if [ "$moved" = true ]; then summary='源位置已不是原对象，目标目录里存在移动后的对象' elif [ "$d" = absent ]; then summary='目标目录里没有该对象，移动没有发生' else summary='目标目录里没有该对象，源位置仍是原对象' fi printf '{"enforced": %s, "summary": "%s", "checks": [{"name": "dest_exists", "observed": "%s", "expected": "present", "matched": %s}, {"name": "src_is_not_the_moved_object", "observed": "%s", "expected": "absent or different inode", "matched": %s}]}\n' \ "$moved" "$summary" "$d" "$dest" "$s" "$moved"
